Normalize Nanostring gene expression data

Source: R/normalizeruvg.R
normalizeruvg.Rd

normalizeruvg is used to normalize the data using RUVg method.

Usage

normalizeruvg(rawdata, fData, pData, hkgenes = "", exclude = NULL, k)

Arguments

rawdata

A matrix of raw expression values of genes.

fData

Feature data.

pData

Phenotype data.

hkgenes

A vector of HouseKeeping gene names.

exclude

A vector of HouseKeeping gene to exclude.

k

The number of dimensions of unwanted variation estimated.

Value

A matrix of log2 transformed normalized genes.

Details

This function is useful when nanostring data has been loaded, quality-checked and is ready to be normalized. Only RUVg method of normalization can be applied.

Author

Jayanth Sreekanth

Examples


path_to_rcc <- system.file("extdata", "GSE146530", package = "rhythmCI")
meta <- system.file("extdata", "meta_GSE146530.csv", package = "rhythmCI")

# Load and No normalization -----------------------------------------------------------------

exp_df1 <- loadnormalizercc(dir = path_to_rcc, meta_dir = meta,
  hkgenes = c("LOC106606270", "LOC106600007"), file_number = FALSE)
df1_raw <- exp_df1$rawdata
df1_pdata <- exp_df1$pData
df1_fdata <- exp_df1$fData
df1_endblod <- exp_df1$num_endogenous_blod

# Perform nSolver normalization ------------------------------------------------------------
suppressMessages(

exp_df3 <- normalizeruvg(rawdata = df1_raw,
  fData = df1_fdata,
  pData = df1_pdata,
  hkgenes = c("LOC106606270", "LOC106600007"),
  exclude = NULL,
  k=3)
)

df3_set <- exp_df3$set
df3_vsd <- exp_df3$vsd
df3_ruvgnormlog2 <- exp_df3$ruvgnormlog2
